create_VideoSubject: create a VideoSubject instance to record RGB frames from dm_env timesteps into a video file
run_VideoSubject_on_next: run the VideoSubject.on_next method to capture and write each timestep's RGB observation frame to a video
test_VideoSubject_init: test the VideoSubject __init__ method with custom root directory, extension, codec, and fps parameters
review_VideoSubject_dispose: review the VideoSubject.dispose method to ensure the video writer is released on cleanup
summarize_VideoSubject: summarize the VideoSubject class that emits a video at the end of each episode by writing RGB frames
